answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A haven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dawn of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
